method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie瞥见Eeling手机屏幕上一个女人的笑脸，确认就是他锁屏照片里抱着小男孩的同一个女人
facts.anchor: Hattie catches a glimpse of a woman’s smiling face on the screen

facts.fact: Eeling接听电话，一边说马上回来一边走到屋外的门廊上
facts.anchor: “I’ll be right back,” and answers the call as he’s stepping outside onto her front porch

facts.fact: Eeling在门廊踱步时，Hattie发现他没有让笔记本睡眠，走到他那侧查看电脑桌面上的文件夹
facts.anchor: he didn’t put the laptop to sleep

facts.fact: Hattie在桌面左下角找到标注TEC的文件夹（Thomas Edwin Conlee，即Tommy）并点击打开
facts.anchor: A file folder at the bottom left marked TEC.

facts.fact: Hattie用了三次才输入正确的自己邮箱地址，把TEC文件夹作为附件点击发送
facts.anchor: she attaches the TEC file folder and hits “Send.”

facts.fact: 系统提示附件过大需要压缩，Hattie点击Yes，进度条开始极其缓慢地填充
facts.anchor: Attachment too large, files must be compressed. Proceed? She clicks “Yes”

facts.fact: Hattie打开Sent列表，点击带小垃圾桶图标的Delete按钮删除已发邮件并确认Yes
facts.anchor: A “Delete” button with a little trash can above it. She punches it.

facts.fact: Eeling走进厨房时，Hattie手中的玻璃杯滑落并在水槽里摔碎
facts.anchor: The glass slips from her fingers and shatters in the sink as Eeling steps into the kitchen.

facts.fact: 一辆绿色SUV停在Eeling车旁，Wendy Crawford和Julian从车里出来径直朝房子走去
facts.anchor: both front doors open and Wendy Crawford climbs out along with Julian
